en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika), The Triplet on the Corrupt (Saṅkiliṭṭhattika)

Conditioned by a state that is non-demonstrable, impinging, and neither defiled nor subject to defilement, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, non-impinging, and defiled and subject to defilement, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, impinging, and neither defiled nor subject to defilement, there arises a state that is demonstrable and impinging...
A non-defiled and defiling state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Twenty-one [ways] for root;
twenty-one for predominance …pe… twenty-one for non-disappearance.
Conditioned by a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and neither-defiled-nor-defiling, [arises] a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive.
An undefiled and non-defiling state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
